calibrationScope: Apple Silicon and Intel Photoshop under Rosetta, compared to the corresponding Photato slice
scope: The grayscale comparison covers the default 32-bit gray destination with relative colorimetric intent, recognized standard RGB primaries, and custom linear RGB matrix profiles whose luminance weights sum to one. Other destination profiles, intents and custom white points still use ColorSync. Eight- and sixteen-bit grayscale conversion, transparent Multiply, and whole-file identity remain open.
